description: Jobs Companies Services Search jobs here LoginRegister For employers Business Analyst Aptonline 3.2194 Reviews 2 - 4 years Not Disclosed Hyderabad Posted: 3 weeks ago Openings: 3 Applicants: 100+ Continue with Google Job description The candidate will act as a bridge between government department officials, project management teams, technical teams, vendors, and end users. The role involves requirement gathering, business process analysis, preparation of functional documentation, coordination with stakeholders, UAT support, project reporting, and monitoring of application implementation. Key Responsibilities Interact with Government Department officials, project stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams to understand business requirements. Gather, analyze, validate, and document functional and non-functional requirements. Prepare BRD, FRD, SRS, FRS, user stories, use cases, process flows, and functional specifications. Study existing government processes and prepare As-Is and To-Be process flows. Conduct gap analysis and identify opportunities for process improvement and digitization. Translate business requirements into clear requirements for development and QA teams. Coordinate with development, testing, implementation, and support teams. Participate in UAT, requirement validation, issue tracking, and resolution coordination. Prepare UAT scenarios, test cases, requirement traceability documents, and sign-off documentation. Coordinate with government users during application implementation and rollout. Prepare MIS reports, dashboards, presentations, MOMs, status reports, and project progress reports. Track project deliverables, milestones, issues, dependencies, and action items. Support project managers in monitoring implementation timelines and deliverables. Coordinate with multiple departments/agencies and ensure timely closure of requirements and issues. Support preparation of project documentation required for reviews, audits, and government meetings. Participate in client meetings, workshops, requirement discussions, demonstrations, and training sessions. Maintain proper documentation and version control of project deliverables. Perform other BA/project-coordination activities assigned by the Project Manager. Required Skills 2 - 4 years of experience as a Business Analyst in IT/software projects. Exposure to Government, PSU, e-Governance, or public-sector projects is preferred. Good understanding of SDLC, Agile and/or Waterfall methodologies. Strong requirement-gathering and business-process-analysis skills. Hands-on experience preparing BRD, FRD/SRS, user stories, use cases, and process-flow diagrams. Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Knowledge of JIRA, Confluence, Visio, Draw.io, or similar tools is preferred. Basic knowledge of SQL and databases is an advantage. Good understanding of UAT, defect tracking, and requirement traceability. Excellent communication and documentation skills. Strong coordination and stakeholder-management abilities. Ability to communicate professionally with senior government officials and project stakeholders.
